scientific_integrity: The infinite degree-at-least-four equivalence is proved by a complete symbolic extension-support table, not inferred from small experiments. Mathematical review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary first-order equality and adjacency through rank four. The possible degree-fifty-seven Moore graph is conditional, not asserted to exist. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed without independent comprehensive verification. The sharp representative bound is relative to diameter-two Moore graphs.
title: Three four-round theories of diameter-two Moore graphs
